end.summary:
Discussed harvest festivals across India, including Pongal, Baisakhi, and Bihu.
Linked Pongal with the new rice crop in mid-January.
Kavya gave one unaided correct link between a harvest festival and crop-readiness season.
The lesson ended before the Baisakhi crop connection was identified.
end.parentNote: Asha practised connecting harvest festivals with the season when crops are ready. Kavya connected Pongal with the new rice crop after prompting; they initially mixed up Diwali with harvest celebrations, and that mix-up was not revisited before the lesson ended. At home, look at a simple calendar and name one crop or harvest linked with each of Pongal and Baisakhi.
